title: Case: Parcel diverted to a pickup point after a missed delivery, recipient cannot collect
context: After a failed home delivery, a parcel of walking boots from Tallowmere Goods was diverted to a pickup point. The recipient says he cannot get there.
initial_request: I have a card saying my boots are at the newsagent on Copperhythe Road. I broke my ankle on the 12th and I'm not supposed to be on it, I was upstairs when the driver knocked and could not get down in time. I can't walk to the shop and my daughter is back at work now. Could they please be brought to the house again, I will make sure the door is answered, I'm in every day.

events.body:
Thanks,
Tamsin
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

DL-3100 (TG-9578, walking boots): home attempt failed 2026-04-18 15:20 UTC, no answer, card left. Diverted to pickup point Copperhythe News & Post, scanned in 2026-04-20 11:05 UTC. Held there until 2026-04-27, then returned to sender. A verified recipient who cannot collect may ask for one home redelivery; the request comes to us on this queue and we decide and recall the parcel. A parcel on a pickup-point shelf is not delivered and the shipment stays open until handover.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

Route plan for depot HL-9 published for Monday. 35 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

acceptable_actions.summary: Request one home redelivery of DL-3100 for a recipient who cannot collect from the pickup point.

must: Sends a home-redelivery request for DL-3100 to the Destination depot, Fallowmere Arc Logistics on the Depot work queue.
States that the recipient cannot collect and will be at home to answer the door, and that the parcel is held at Copperhythe News & Post until 2026-04-27.
Leaves the decision, the recall and any date to the depot.
must_not: Mark or describe the case as closed or resolved, or describe DL-3100 as delivered.
Take no action on the grounds that the parcel has reached the pickup point.
Promise the recipient a redelivery or a redelivery date.
Tell the pickup point to release the parcel to the daughter or anyone else, or arrange a third-party collection.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Home redelivery request for DL-3100 (TG-9578, walking boots). Home attempt failed 2026-04-18; the parcel was scanned in at Copperhythe News & Post on 2026-04-20 and the pickup point confirms it is on their shelf, held until 2026-04-27. The recipient, Marisol Fairweather, writing from his Customer portal account, cannot collect: he has a broken ankle and cannot walk to the shop, and was unable to reach the door in time on the 18th. He says he is at home every day and will make sure the door is answered. Please decide whether you will recall it for one home redelivery and tell me the date so I can let him know. Nothing has been promised to him.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-707: people, organisations and references renamed. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
